v4_composition_update: tools/trigger2_hyperposition_state_history_generation_bound_gate_v4.py remaining_p0 item 'immutable genesis/ordered-history producer authority is required before nonempty-history positives' moved to a new closed_p0 list, since v4's generation stage (its first, non-short-circuitable composition stage) now structurally enforces this on every adjudication call, not just claims it as a future requirement.

hypothesis_and_implications.hypothesis: The gap existed because trigger2_generation_provenance_gate_v1 was originally scoped to a single evaluator-subject case (one event), and nothing ever extended that authority to cover multi-event history CONTENT even though the replay-integrity gate (trigger2_hyperposition_state_history_proof_gate_v1) already enforced STRUCTURAL replay correctness. The two concerns (content provenance vs structural replay) were conflated in the remaining_p0 wording but actually needed separate closure -- structural was already closed, content was not.
hypothesis_and_implications.implication_for_future_history_cases: Any future nonempty-history positive candidate now needs its own authorized case in TRIGGER2_TRUSTED_SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR_AUTHORITY_V1.json (or a generalized case-family mechanism if history shapes proliferate) -- this does not scale past a handful of hand-registered histories without a follow-up generalization (e.g. a parametric case template), which was intentionally NOT built here to avoid over-engineering ahead of actual pilot demand.
hypothesis_and_implications.implication_for_phase6_nuisance_audit: The now-mandatory genesis_state/event_history byte-identity check in generation provenance is itself a new authoritative-vs-nuisance surface: any future rendering/serialization normalization work (Phase 6.2 nuisance audit) must treat these two fields as authoritative content, not nuisance, or it will silently break this closure.
hypothesis_and_implications.known_seam_documented_not_fixed: row['source_binding'] is read by two different gates for two different purposes on the same row (trigger2_generation_provenance_gate_v1 wants it to resolve to the trusted generator; trigger2_hyperposition_derivation_bound_gate_v2 wants it to resolve to whatever path it's given, which happens to also need to match). They compose correctly today because trigger2_hyperposition_derivation_bound_gate_v2.current_source_binding() is path-generic and returns a superset of keys generation-provenance reads, but a future change to either gate's expectations could silently break this composition. Worth a dedicated regression test file at the v4-integration level (not just per-gate) if this project continues -- explicitly deferred here as out of Phase 3's scope.

evidence_scope: immutable genesis/ordered-history producer authority component only
